name: Xǔ Àiyōu
source: The first female lead in the true ending and the owner of the "XY" real-life escape room shop. 8 years of industry experience, she owns multiple shops, is a business tycoon and multimillionaire, a master of emotional manipulation, a "succubus in human form", the promotional figurehead for the escape room, and the lifelong rival of the male protagonist.
translation: The first female lead in the true ending and the owner of the "XY" real-life escape room shop. 8 years of industry experience, she owns multiple shops, is a business tycoon and multimillionaire, a master of emotional manipulation, a "succubus in human form", the promotional figurehead for the escape room, and the lifelong rival of the male protagonist.
